audio_caption: The audio clip begins with a male speaker remarking about a mask, commenting that it's "like he's saying, say what?". Another male speaker retorts that at least his mouth isn't sewn shut. A third male voice follows with "My mouth is rotting away!" These words are followed by indistinct muttering noises, building up until a loud crash interrupts the muttering. Amidst the sounds of crashing, one of the male speakers shouts what sounds like "No way!", and then "Oh God".

The clip begins with an excited, male speaker describing being in Jonesboro, Arkansas, prompted to enter a Spirit Halloween store by a "weiner dog". He believes the building used to be a Pier One Imports and hopes to find "awesome props and masks" and "animatronics".

The clip starts with speech, a male voice exclaiming, "holy crap guys!" followed by a description of a figure inside a door. The speaker expresses surprise at having never seen it before, and encourages the figure to move, referring to it as "Mr. Skeleton Zombie Guy," and finally describing its various features. The speaker describes the figure's skeleton feet, zombie or mummy hands, and a zombie face. The speaker then expresses his curiosity about the figure, asking listeners to identify it in the comments below. Interspersed with the speech are ghoulish sounds that suggest the figure is making noise even when not moving. The clip ends with speech, the same male voice, as he talks to his listeners, and asks them to comment if they recognize the figure.

The audio clip features a male speaker excitedly commenting on the availability of "Beetlejuice" products, emphasizing their stock and expressing surprise that the imports arrived. The primary sound is the speaker's enthusiastic voice, suggesting a retail or fan setting.

The audio begins with speech, where one male speaker, sounding slightly excited, exclaims "Oh my gosh, they have two Baphomets." He then clarifies his pronunciation and points out the presence of two "Ghostfaces" in stock. He notes that the lighting makes it difficult to see the objects.

The audio starts with a single male speaker with a curious tone, describing items, one called "Henry Hustle" as reduced in price, possibly a "victim of a TikTok charade," followed by "Maestro and Little Daisy." He states a price for the latter and mentions damage to the items. He specifies for "Henry Hustle" that "head sits sideways and does not pop up correctly." For the other item, he says "the girl's neck is broken" with some humor, saying "that's almost cool."

The audio clip starts with an energetic male speaker enthusiastically saying "Oh and look over here guys." He references the movie Stand by Me, mentions leeches, and indicates a different kind of leech is present. The speaker gets even more excited exclaiming "Holy crap guys" and begins counting a collection of pop vinyl figures, stating there are six of them, then he lists further figures. The same male speaker transitions into describing the location with "What in the world" before abruptly introducing background music with a soft romantic feel; the speaker then notes, "cue Barry White". The music plays as the speaker mentions moving elsewhere, hoping to find more animatronics. Finally, he exclaims "Oh".

The audio clip opens with a male speaker expressing interest in a spooky scene, specifically noting "chains of death" and "spooky bricks" displayed there. This is followed by the same speaker's reaction to "shorty's clubs" and a light-up "ghost face" costume. He expresses his delight, describing it as "cool" and wishing the eyes would light up as well. He then says that he is liking the store. The speaker expresses surprise at the overwhelming number of astronaut helmets, wondering if everyone wants to be an astronaut.

The audio clip features a male speaker, excited, describing the appearance of Halloween decorations, including "white ones," a "blue shield," and "black ones," also mentioning "ghostface," "posible dummies," "Chucky greeters," an "empty soul girl," a "creepy crimson girl," and "Michael Myers greeter." He transitions to discussing "animatronics" and notes the absence of certain setups, expressing disappointment. He then describes "spooky bricks" and "chains of death," as well as other items, speculating they will be for sale. His tone remains energetic as he shifts focus to another section. In the background, atmospheric music plays, creating a spooky and anticipatory mood, alongside the ambient noise of a store environment.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker excitedly describing "Sam Groundbreakers" at the "end," followed by him commenting on seeing the "trick or treat wagon" for the second time. He notes "Sam Sidesteppers" and has them both activated together, although he quickly tells them he has heard enough of them. The speaker then mentions a "scary gargoyle pathway marker," followed by "burning skull pathway markers." Someone then notes, "Hello rats," followed by descriptions of "skeleton candle holders" and the phrase "Hear no evil, see no evil, speak no evil," then addresses those who say bad words.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker enthusiastically describing animatronics, starting with a "night crawler" reduced in price, then mentioning "a hauntress." He then mentions decaying "zombie ground breakers," and tests one, noticing its "green eyes." Finally, he describes "a pose and stay skeleton."

The clip begins with the sound of background music. A male voice introduces the light-up balloons from Pennywise in the It movies, expressing enthusiasm. The speaker continues describing the flaming pumpkins, noting the flames' height, followed by comments on a grotesque face with a protruding tongue and barbed wire. The same speaker then announces "Welcome to Skid Row," before adding that they got "a whole plethora of zombies here," commenting humorously on one zombie's need for a new hairdo. The music and ambient sounds continue in the background.

The clip opens with a male speaker enthusiastically describing Halloween decorations, including "the kicking clown" and "Mr. Vintage Frankenstein". He continues to point out a devil, a nurse he says was fired for refusing the COVID shot, and a figure who "gnawed his arm off." He jokingly greets "other rats" and expresses apologizes after spotting "jumping spiders". Throughout the speech, there is noticeable background music, a cheerful and upbeat Halloween-themed tune.

The clip begins with a male speaker excitedly suggesting a walk. He then describes items like a "Malachi knife" and "blood-curdling knives" from a store, noting their appearance. He jokingly interacts with a mask, and mentions seeing a Phantom of the Opera mask. Next, he mentions a Jolly Wally mask and some stickers. He then jokingly addresses an unknown figure, signing off the audio clip with Jonesboro, Arkansas. This is immediately followed by upbeat, distorted music. An excited male voice yells over the music "I told you to stay away!". There is then a gasp from the speaker, followed by a chilling sound effect.
